properties.Time Table Transformations:
SELECT 
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM time_key) AS time_key,
    trans_day AS transaction_day,
    trans_hour AS transaction_hour,
    trans_month AS transaction_month,
    trans_year AS transaction_year,
    trans_date AS transaction_date,
	TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM REPLACE(trans_week, ' Week', '')) AS transaction_week,
	TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM REPLACE(trans_quarter, 'Q', '')) AS transaction_quarter
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Transaction Table Transformations:
SELECT 
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM payment_key) AS payment_key,
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM trans_type) AS transaction_type,
	TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM REPLACE(bank_name, '\\r', '')) AS bank_name
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Store Table Transformations:
SELECT 
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM store_key) AS store_key,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM division) AS division,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM district) AS district,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM REPLACE(upazila, '\\r', '')) AS upazila
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Item Table Transformations:
SELECT 
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM item_key) AS item_key,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM item_name) AS item_name,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM item_desc) AS item_description,
    unit_price,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM man_country) AS man_country,
    TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM REPLACE(supplier, '\\\"', '')) AS supplier
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Customer Table Transformations:
SELECT
	TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM customer_key) AS customer_key,
	COALESCE(TRIM(BOTH ' ' FROM customer_name), 'No Name Provided') AS customer_name,
	contact_no AS customer_contact_number,
	nid AS internal_customer_id
FROM FLOWFILE

properties.Fact Table Transformations:
SELECT 
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM payment_key) AS payment_key,
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM customer_key) AS customer_key,
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM time_key) AS time_key,
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM item_key) AS item_key,
    TRIM (BOTH ' ' FROM store_key) AS store_key,
    quantity,
    CASE unit 
        WHEN 'ct\.' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Ct' THEN 0
        WHEN 'ct' THEN 0
        WHEN 'Bags' THEN 1
        WHEN 'oz\.' THEN 2
        WHEN 'oz' THEN 2
        WHEN 'cartons' THEN 3
        WHEN 'lb' THEN 4
        WHEN 'pack' THEN 5
        WHEN 'pk' THEN 5
        WHEN 'botlltes' THEN 6
        WHEN 'bottles' THEN 6
        ELSE -1
    END AS unit,
    unit_price,
    total_price
FROM FLOWFILE
